image_description: A close-up view of a vintage comic book cover featuring stylized, somewhat grotesque character illustrations. The cover has a red header with bold, distorted yellow and black typography. Two main characters are visible: one in a pink outfit holding an object, and another in dark clothing with pale skin. The art style is reminiscent of underground comix or horror comics. There are signs of wear and tear on the physical object.

artifact_observations.reasoning: The title text is heavily distorted and largely illegible. While this could be a stylistic choice for a horror/underground comic, AI generators often struggle with coherent typography, resulting in 'fake' letters that mimic structure but lack semantic validity. The characters appear melted and inconsistent.

The hands and the object being held by the character in pink show slight structural ambiguity and blending. The fingers lack clear definition and seem to merge slightly with the object, a common AI artifact in complex hand-object interactions.
The background details are somewhat indistinct and blend into the characters' outlines, lacking the sharp separation typically found in printed comic art. This suggests minor generative bleeding.

To check for boundary bleeding between characters and the background, and to ensure hands/objects are topologically distinct entities.
To assess overall print quality simulation and detect any subtle generative artifacts in texture or lighting.

focus_areas: Legibility and structural integrity of the title typography
Anatomical correctness of hands and held objects
Boundary sharpness between foreground characters and background

custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the text auditor's findings. If the text is confirmed as gibberish, this is a strong indicator of AI generation despite the stylistic excuse of 'horror font'. Also, verify if the hand/object fusion is a result of low-resolution scanning of a real comic or a generative error. Real comics usually have clean ink lines even in rough styles.
